card.name: Monitoring of lithium levels, plus stray cases
card.fires_on: The word 'of' after 'monitoring' in lithium interaction warnings, and the following word 'lithium'. It also fires on scattered words in old narrative or reference text.

modes.label: Lithium monitoring
modes.description: 'of' or 'lithium' in phrases about monitoring serum lithium levels when lithium is given with ACE inhibitors or NSAIDs.
modes.example: These drugs should be co-administered with caution and frequent monitoring<< of>> serum lithium levels is recommended.

modes.label: Scattered narrative words
modes.description: A verb or noun in historical or narrative prose, such as 'came' after a subject noun or 'World' in a fair's name.
